room_rent.display: Single Private A/C Room (no cap within this)
room_rent.note: No room rent limit if occupancy is Single Private A/C Room or lower. Proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses if higher room chosen.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states proportionate deduction will not apply on ICU charges.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise sub-limits found in the policy wording.

deductible.note: No aggregate or base deductible mentioned.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is only 6 months of continuous coverage from policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (sinusitis, hernia, kidney stones, haemorrhoids, hysterectomy, etc.) have a 6-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Only ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: All eligible day-care procedures covered under the policy.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered subject to medical certification of inability to be moved or non-availability of hospital room.

ayush.note: No mention of AYUSH treatment coverage in the policy wording.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered where insured is the recipient.

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance covered for transport to hospital or between hospitals for medical reasons; no rupee cap stated.

modern_treatments.note: All 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered with no stated sub-limit.

consumables.display: List I items covered; standard consumables excluded
consumables.note: Specific List I toiletries/personal comfort items are payable. Standard consumables like gloves, masks, etc. are subsumed into room/procedure charges and not separately payable.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly restricts coverage to treatment taken within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual premium; 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for half-yearly/quarterly.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, overseas treatment, external congenital anomaly, self-inflicted injury, hearing aids, contact lenses, preventive vaccinations

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers described in this policy document.
